events.title: Redmond Ganesh Festival
events.loc: Marymoor Park , 6046 W. Lake Sammamish Pkwy. N.E., Redmond
events.desc: A 15-foot Ganesh idol — the tallest in the United States — will greet you at this cultural celebration. Experience a colorful parade, special performances and spiritual chanting. There will also be live music, delicious food and a shopping bazaar with fantastic finds.

events.title: Kenmore Oktoberfest
events.cost: Free; some activities require a fee
events.desc: A full weekend of Oktoberfest activities awaits. Celebrate on Friday with a Bavarian band at Copperworks Kenmore, or head to Saint Edward State Park on Saturday for wiener dog races. Then close out the weekend with Oktoberfest games and more at Stoup Brewing. Prost!

events.title: Fremont Arts Council Luminata
events.loc: Green Lake Aqua Theater , West Green Lake Way North, Seattle
events.desc: I love walking around Green Lake any time of the year, but this weekend brings an extra-special reason: the beloved Luminata, an illuminated lantern procession. Before the sun sets, you can head to the Green Lake Aqua Theater at 5 p.m. for kids crafts. The lantern shop opens at 5:30 p.m. if you’d like to purchase one in support of the Fremont Arts Council before the lantern procession starts at…

events.title: Firefighters to the Rescue
events.loc: Highline Heritage Museum , 819 S.W. 152nd St., Burien
events.desc: Teacher Nikki leads hands-on activities for kids during this firefighter-themed event. From story time to fire truck songs and puzzles, it’s a sweet way to learn a bit more about what firefighters do. Kids will also learn more about forest animals. There are plenty of exhibits to see at the museum, including a replica megalonyx skeleton.

events.title: Monster Jam Seattle
events.loc: Lumen Field , 800 Occidental Ave. S., Seattle
events.desc: Monster Jam is back! Splurge on tickets (and bring earplugs) for the whole family, so you can watch in awe as 12,000-pound trucks speed across the dirt and fly through the air. Expect epic stunts and unforgettable competitions. One of the trucks is even Spider-Man themed!

events.title: ChuSeok Korean Festival
events.loc: Asia Pacific Cultural Center , 4851 S. Tacoma Way, Tacoma
events.desc: I love any excuse to delight in the change in seasons (and eat delicious food). This festival celebrates autumn eve and the harvest tradition with drum dances, paper lotus flowers and music. There will be different activities and vendors adding to the experience, and it’s a great place to meet people in the community and celebrate together.

events.title: Salmon Homecoming
events.desc: The Seattle Waterfront is the place to be this weekend. Celebrate Indigenous culture and conservation efforts with coastal songs, dances and a canoe landing. There will also be a waterfront vendor market, along with a weaving workshop.

events.title: Stocker Farms Fall Festival
events.cost: $17.95–$30.95; discounts available; age 2 and younger are free
events.desc: It’s opening weekend for one of my favorite fall festivals. With more than 30 different farm attractions, plan to spend the whole day here (and leave with a pumpkin or two). There’s a corn maze, jumping pillows, a mega slide, a climbing wall and a U-pick pumpkin patch. Don’t miss the doughnuts!

events.title: Seattle Fiestas Patrias
events.loc: Seattle Center Armory , 305 Harrison St., Seattle
events.desc: Celebrate the independence and culture of Latin American countries during this two-day festival. There will be cooking demonstrations, live music, performances, art exhibitions and plenty more. The kids will love the bouncy obstacle course, crafts, temporary tattoos and soccer activities.

events.title: Seahawks Watch Party at Legacy Square
events.loc: Legacy Square , 510 S. Third St., Renton
events.desc: It’s football season! Watch the Seahawks face off against the Arizona Cardinals during this epic watch party. Get there early for pregame festivities, including futsal and yard games. Go Hawks!
